## What you do not need today

::: {.none}
- No git, and no GitHub account
- No OSF account – we will read OSF, not log into it
- No working installation yet: the browser lab runs R inside the web page, and Task 1 sets yours up
- Nothing to sign up for; nothing leaves your machine except the results you choose to submit
:::

::: {.fragment}
**Do this now:** open your workspace folder in your IDE, and open the browser lab in a tab beside it; R loads in the page while we talk.
:::

::: notes
Before anything else, the reassurance slide. You do not need git today, or a GitHub account, or an OSF account – we will look at OSF from the outside, like readers. If your installation is not working yet, that is fine: the browser lab runs R inside the page itself, and there is a task later in this part where we get everybody set up properly. One thing to do right now, while I talk. Open the workspace folder in your IDE, then open the browser lab in a tab beside it and just leave it. R loads in the background there, so it will be ready long before you need it. If you are on the call with one screen, the setup page has a tip: put the meeting on your phone or a second window and keep your IDE full-screen.
:::
